name: logo_big
text: The logo reads 'Classic' in red script with an orange outline, and below it 'BLACK' and 'JACK' in red distressed block letters on light blue rounded tiles with a golden outer outline.

name: badge_25_top
text: The sign shows a big glowing orange-red number '25' and below it the small text '175' and 'BONUS'.

name: badge_25_second
text: The sign shows a big glowing orange-red number '25' and below it the small text '175' and 'BONUS'.

name: match_play_plus
text: The red sign reads 'MATCH' on the first line and 'PLAY' on the second line, with a '+' sign and the small word 'PLUS' on its right.

name: super_classic_bj
text: The sign has the yellow word 'SUPER' on top and below it a small 'Classic BLACK JACK' logo: red script 'Classic' and red block letters 'BLACK' and 'JACK' on light blue tiles.

name: match_play_right
text: The red sign reads 'MATCH' on the first line and 'PLAY' on the second line.

name: badge_20_left
text: The sign shows the big glowing orange-red number '20'.

name: classic_bj_small
text: The sign shows a small 'Classic BLACK JACK' logo: red script 'Classic' and red block letters 'BLACK' and 'JACK' on light blue tiles.

name: super_lepesek
text: The red sign reads 'SUPER' on the first line and 'LÉPÉSEK' on the second line (Hungarian, with accents on both É letters).

name: plus_stop
text: Two stacked signs: the upper green sign reads 'PLUS' and the lower red sign reads 'STOP'.

name: badge_10_left
text: The sign shows the big glowing orange-red number '10'.

name: badge_4_left
text: The sign shows the big glowing orange-red number '4'.

name: wheel
text: A round wheel with eight fruit-machine symbols around a centre panel: BAR sign at the top, a red bunch of grapes, a golden bell, an orange, a small 'Classic BLACK JACK' logo, a green watermelon, a yellow lemon and a blue plum. The centre panel reads 'HA' 'MINDEN' 'VILÁGÍT' (Hungarian, with accent on Á) above a big '25' and the small text '175 BONUS'.

name: lepes_fel_le
text: Two red house-shaped signs: the upper one reads 'LÉPÉS' and 'FEL', the lower one reads 'LÉPÉS' and 'LE' (Hungarian, with accents on the É letters).

name: helps_row
text: A row of four small signs, from left to right: 'DUPLA BLACK JACK', 'EXTRA LÉPÉS', 'JÓ AZ EGYENLŐ', 'MÁSIK KÁRTYA' (Hungarian, keep the accents). Keep the tiny fine print below them as neat illegible lines.

name: joker_face
text: A cartoon joker jester face with a red and yellow hat and the word 'JOKER' on the hat.

name: right_header
text: Three signs in a row: on the left the yellow word 'SUPER' above a small 'BLACK JACK' logo, in the middle the yellow word 'DUPLA', on the right a small 'Classic BLACK JACK' logo.

name: right_grid
text: A grid of glowing orange-red number signs in two columns with red circles between them. Rows from top: '25' circle '21' '25'; '25' circle '20' '25'; '25' circle '19' '25'; '25' circle '18' '20'; '20' circle '17' '10'. Keep the small subtext below each number exactly as it appears; do not invent it.

name: kartya_pontszam
text: A thin label reading 'KÁRTYA PONTSZÁM' (Hungarian, with accents on both Á letters).

name: arrow_track
text: A red snake-like track of arrow-shaped fields with small numbers in circles: '16' at the top, '13' '14' '15' in the upper row, '12' '11' '10' '9' '8' in the middle row, '7' on the right, and '1' to '6' in the bottom row. Keep the large red box on the right with its faint lettering exactly as it is.
